violations.description: Other reservations can be modified without changing the origin, destination, and trip type.
violations.reason: The existing reservation GJLSXX had a CLT→EWR flight segment (step 7), but the agent proposed and then applied a change to HAT087 CLT→LGA on 2024-05-26 (steps 15-16, 20), and the resulting reservation contains the flight segment with destination LGA (step 21). This changes the reservation's destination from EWR to LGA, which violates the policy that modifications must not change the origin, destination, and trip type.
